title: CI Core Engine
text: Compression-ignition engine from intake to exhaust port, 7 inputs, 4 outputs; {Torque model} selects torque model, {Number of cylinders, NCyl} sets the engine cylinders, {Air standard temperature, Pstd} sets the temperature, {Crank revolutions per power stroke, Cps} sets the revolutions per stroke, {Total displaced volume, Vd} sets the volume, {Ideal gas constant air, Rair} sets the constant, {Air standard pressure, Pstd} sets the pressure, {Speed-density volumetric efficiency, f_nv} sets the lookup table array, {Speed-density intake manifold pressure breakpoints, f_nv_prs_bpt} sets the breakpoints vector, {Speed-density engine speed breakpoints, f_nv_n_bpt} sets the breakpoints vector, {Torque table, f_tq_nf} sets the lookup table array, {Torque table fuel mass per injection breakpoints, f_tq_nf_f_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Torque table speed breakpoints, f_tq_nf_n_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Fuel mass per injection breakpoints, f_tqs_f_bpt} sets the breakpoints vector, {Engine speed breakpoints, f_tqs_n_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Optimal main start of injection timing, f_tqs_mainsoi} sets the optimal MAINSOI array, {Optimal intake manifold gas pressure, f_tqs_map} sets the optimal intake MAP array, {Optimal exhaust manifold gas pressure, f_tqs_emap} sets the optimal exhaust MAP array, {Optimal intake manifold gas temperature, f_tqs_mat} sets the optimal intake MAT array, {Optimal intake gas oxygen percent, f_tqs_o2pct} sets the optimal intake gas, {Optimal fuel rail pressure, f_tqs_fuelpress} sets the optimal fuel rail, {Optimal gross indicated mean effective pressure, f_tqs_imepg} sets the optimal mean effective, {Optimal friction mean effective pressure, f_tqs_fmep}, {Optimal pumping mean effective pressure, f_tqs_pmep}, {Friction multiplier as a function of temperature, f_tqs_fric_temp_mod} sets the friction multiplier array, {Friction multiplier temperature breakpoints, f_tqs_fric_temp_bpt} sets the breakpoints vector, {Main start of injection timing efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_mainsoi_eff} sets the mAINSOI efficiency multiplier array, {Main start of injection timing relative to optimal timing breakpoints, f_tqs_mainsoi_delta_bpt} sets the breakpoints vector, {Intake manifold gas pressure efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_map_eff} sets the intake pressure efficiency multiplier, {Intake manifold gas pressure ratio relative to optimal pressure ratio breakpoints, f_tqs_map_ratio_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Intake manifold gas lambda breakpoints, f_tqs_lambda_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Intake manifold gas temperature efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_mat_eff} sets the intake temperature efficiency multiplier, {Intake manifold gas temperature relative to optimal gas temperature breakpoints, f_tqs_mat_delta_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Intake manifold gas oxygen efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_o2pct_eff} sets the intake oxygen efficiency, {Intake gas oxygen percent relative to optimal breakpoints, f_tqs_o2pct_delta_bpt} sets the breakpoints vector, {Fuel rail pressure efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_fuelpress_eff} sets the efficiency multiplier array, {Fuel rail pressure relative to optimal breakpoints, f_tqs_fuelpress_delta_bpt} sets the breakpoints vector, {Fuel mass injection type identifier, f_tqs_f_inj_type} sets the type identifier, {Indicated mean effective pressure post inject correction, f_tqs_imep_post_corr} sets the post inject correction array, {Indicated mean effective pressure post inject mass sum breakpoints, f_tqs_f_post_sum_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Indicated mean effective pressure post inject start of inject timing centroid breakpoints, f_tqs_soi_post_cent_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Maximum start of injection angle for burned fuel, f_tqs_f_burned_soi_limit} sets the maximum SOI angle for burned fuel, {Exhaust temperature table, f_t_exh} sets the lookup table array, {Fuel mass per injection breakpoints, f_t_exh_f_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Speed breakpoints, f_t_exh_n_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Optimal exhaust manifold gas temperature, f_tqs_exht}, {Main start of injection timing exhaust temperature efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_exht_mainsoi_eff} sets the main SOI timing efficiency multiplier, {Intake manifold gas pressure exhaust temperature efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_exht_map_eff} sets the intake manifold efficiency multiplier, {Intake manifold gas temperature exhaust temperature efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_exht_mat_eff} sets the intake manifold efficiency multiplier, {Intake manifold gas oxygen exhaust temperature efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_exht_o2pct_eff} sets the intake manifold efficiency multiplier, {Fuel rail pressure exhaust temperature efficiency multiplier, f_tqs_exht_fuelpress_eff}, {Post-injection cylinder wall heat loss transfer coefficient, f_tqs_exht_post_inj_wall_htc} sets the post-injection offset, {CO2 mass fraction table, f_CO2_frac} sets the carbon dioxide, {CO mass fraction table, f_CO_frac} sets the carbon monoxide, {HC mass fraction table, f_HC_frac} sets the hydrocarbon, {NOx mass fraction table, f_NOx_frac} sets the nitric oxide and nitrogen dioxide, {PM mass fraction table, f_PM_frac} sets the particulate matter, {Engine speed breakpoints, f_exhfrac_n_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Engine torque breakpoints, f_exhfrac_trq_bpt} sets the breakpoints, {Exhaust gas specific heat at constant pressure, cp_exh} sets the specific heat, {Stoichiometric air-fuel ratio, afr_stoich} sets the air-fuel ratio, {Fuel lower heating value, fuel_lhv} sets the heating value 42e6 and {Fuel specific gravity, fuel_sg} sets the specific gravity. Values come from the instance.
